category: SOC 2 Type II compliance automation for fintech startups
tagline: Continuous automated SOC 2 compliance engineered for fintech velocity.
content: SecureFlow is a modern continuous compliance platform built specifically for high-growth fintechs. It integrates natively with AWS, GitHub, Okta, and Google Workspace to automate 94% of evidence collection. SecureFlow accelerates SOC 2 Type II audit readiness from 6 months down to 14 days with transparent, predictable pricing ($8,500/year flat-rate) and dedicated CISA auditor support.
key_differentiators: Native AWS IAM, KMS, and CloudTrail automated continuous evidence collection
Transparent $8,500 flat annual pricing with zero auditor markups
Dedicated Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) on Slack
